description: AC prices are rising ahead of Diwali and winter, with brands like Daikin and Blue Star increasing costs. Stockpiles from earlier purchases may offer some price relief to buyers during the festive season.

title: India’s festive ad boom runs into a measurement problem
description: As festive advertising intensifies, media fragmentation creates challenges for advertisers to gauge campaign performance across multiple platforms. With digital viewing surging, the risk of fraud increases, and marketers must focus on cohesive measurement.

description: BJP MP Raghav Chadha, in a social media post on Sunday, announced that the Centre has introduced the Telecom Consumer Protection (Thirteenth Amendment) Regulations, 2026, under which prepaid mobile users will have a 30-day recharge plan.

description: India's NHAI will standardise high-speed national highways based on traffic assessments, focusing on safety and efficient movement.&nbsp;

description: To reduce the impact of the strike on customers, the government has directed all Public Sector Banks and Regional Rural Banks to function normally on Sunday, September 27

description: The dispute revolves around the proposed commercial use of a strictly residential property.

description: The apex accounting body highlighted that the proposed bank strike comes at a time when several important statutory and regulatory compliance deadlines are approaching

description: In a first, the government is shipping buffer-stock onions to district markets and small towns to check price spillovers and curb festive season inflation.

description: Following an expired licensing deal on 31 October 2025, Zee has filed a non-compliance plea against JioStar, claiming the broadcaster continues to stream its music without authorization.

description: The lender, based in Thrissur, Kerala, plans to expand in Maharashtra, Gujarat and the national capital.

description: The plan to build the critical storage capacity will require an investment of  ₹15,000 crore, adding to the country’s existing capacity of 12 days across more than 20 tanks

description: The airline's performance has deteriorated sharply this year. In January, one in 15 SpiceJet flights was delayed by more than two hours. By May, the number rose to one in six, and in two months, by July, it further climbed to roughly one out of three.

title: FSSAI moves to stop dairy analogues from being sold as paneer
description: This comes against the backdrop of concerns regarding the rising use of ‘paneer analogue’— a cheaper substitute mainly made from palm oil, milk powder, starch, and emulsifiers, instead of fresh milk.

title: NPCI says no immediate plan to review MDR, charges needed to fund technology and cybersecurity
description: The NPCI is unlikely to modify the reintroduced MDR charges on UPI transactions, emphasizing the need for investment in technology and security. Despite concerns over costs potentially affecting customers, Asbe believes transaction volumes could grow as industry reinvests in the ecosystem.

description: Jio-BP and Nayara Energy have capped diesel sales at select outlets as crude crosses $117/barrel, squeezing OMC margins by  ₹9/litre. PSU retailers (IOC, BPCL, HPCL) — 90% of stations — continue to sell without restrictions. Saudi Aramco's pipeline attack disrupts supply further.

title: Mint Explainer | Are AI companies reshaping India’s ad market?
description: Digital ad impressions rose 44% in January-July, with services, software, and AI companies expanding the market beyond e-commerce.

title: Banks, NBFC insurance income at risk on Irdai fee caps

The proposals may pressure earnings at lenders and insurers, triggering a sell-off in related stocks.

title: Mint Explainer | Why NHRC wants India’s drugs regulator to build a national digital registry
description: The proposed system would use unique QR codes and drug-tracking tools to verify medicines, trace their movement and help enforcement agencies identify counterfeit-drug networks.

description: GIFT IFSC reinsurance business surges as foreign reinsurers seek regulatory preference, lower costs and access to India’s growing insurance market.&nbsp;

description: Irdai's proposed registry could link policy, claims and risk data across insurers while connecting insurance with lenders, identity systems and public databases.
